notes.title: Release date set for 2026
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45603620/5c8a0b07f889ddc6faee200fc76095841667b797.png"][/img][/p][p]As foreshadowed in the previous announcement, the release date for Lobstar: Arcade Version has indeed been moved and set to next year's National Lobster Day.[/p][p]The goal of this project is to make something I'm personally satisfied with, and my development pace behind the scenes has shifted drastically over the last few months. Thus, a couple more months beyond September 2025 are needed to hit my personal minimum bar for release. 
I would like this game to come out on September 25 specifically for thematic and memetic reasons, so that means a one year delay.[/p][p][/p][p]Rest assured, it'll still be released for free.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for reading,[/p][p]Lobstar Dev[/p]

notes.title: Note about Release Date
notes.notes: [p]Hello, and thanks to all reading for your interest in this strange lobster game.[/p][p]Lobstar: Arcade Version is set to release on National Lobster Day as observed in the US--September 25th--because I can.[/p][p]Though the date is set, the year may change. It'll release on September 25th of some year, either this one or a future one.[/p][p]If the year is moved, I'll send out an announcement.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for your understanding,[/p][p]Lobstar Dev[/p]
